_meta.description: FacetSchema summarising a filtered customers cohort's income distribution (numeric arm with histogram + percentiles) decorated with an OVERLAY_KS_VS_POP scalar overlay that runs a Kolmogorov-Smirnov two-sample test against the resolver-supplied population numeric distribution. NUMERIC-arm-only FACET-host inferential kind — pairs with OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_POP (18_facet_chisq_vs_pop.json) which serves the discrete arm. KS emits D = sup_x |F_subset(x) - F_pop(x)| plus the asymptotic p-value via the canonical kolmogorovSurvival helper backing TEST_KS (byte-equal for the same D + N). Reconstructs both empirical CDFs from histograms (preferred precision) or percentiles (fallback) since the FacetPopulationView discards raw values after the Welford fold. Inherently buffered (inferential FACET-host family). Empty distributions or missing histogram + percentile knobs emit NaN + PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO.
_meta.name: facet-ks-vs-pop
